title: Roadmap
useWhen: You want to know what shipped in v2 and what is planned next.
summary: What the v2 Atlas rebuild delivered, and the prioritised next horizons — all constrained by local-first, privacy-first, MIT.
plaintext: Shipped — v2.0.0 “Atlas” July 2026 Complete cosmic UI rebuild: 14 tabs, mascot hub, orb navigation, mobile first responsive. Curriculum lenses: CAPS, IEB, Cambridge A Levels, Global — Grade 1 to post matric with no ceiling. Mastery engine: five dimensions, four bands, spaced repetition, XP/badges, Data Desk analytics. Mathaloid Brain v2 : step by step linear & quadratic solvers, polynomial calculus, fractions/percentages/number theory, 18+ concept explainers, adaptive quizzes — 100% on device. Documentation system: Markdown canonical guides with generated HTML/JSON counterparts, themed portal, docs:build / docs:check pipeline Lehro house pattern . Next horizons Priority Item Notes P1 More games per band Target: every skill category has ≥2 game formats P1 Printable worksheet generator Client side print stylesheets; still zero server P2 PWA install + full offline cache Service worker; keeps the zero request promise P2 i18n scaffolding Afrikaans + isiZulu first; lens aware terminology P2 Teacher mode Local class lists via import/export codes — no accounts P3 A Level depth pack Vectors, mechanics applications, further calculus P3 Opt in local small model experiment Only if it runs fully on device and degrades gracefully; deterministic brain stays the default P3 Accessibility audit round 2 Screen reader passes on all games Non goals permanent Accounts, cloud sync, telemetry, ads, or any server dependency. Paid tiers — the tool is MIT and free forever.
